question: Does the K22-residual second-star carrier (rank 4), riding the conditional-repair card, reduce the host's raw final-layer error on the protected native roster - and is the removed component one the frozen observer could already reconstruct?
hypothesis: The transport-fidelity probe proved the deployed quartic star push is exact on its carried family while the K22-residual channel (computed and discarded at every reset) is transported at exactly zero; the S localization tied born error to fourth-order pair structure (+0.335). The target-free eight-row A/B measured final-output movement of 0.24-0.52 of the total error scale (median 0.32) at mean 209.7e9 added FLOPs, fitting the repair-funded budget on every row. Direction is the open question this pilot decides.

authority.parity_gate_of_record: rank-0 carrier is bit-exact and FLOP-equal to the W3 base (AB_K22R_PROBE.json parity_gate)

k22r4.note: The base estimator plus exactly the seven audited K22-carrier replacements at K22R_RANK=4; no other change.

amendment_log: v1 (sha 0ecbbd49...) FAILED the independent pre-data audit: the k31 channel emitted exactly twice the true transported entry (ordered-sum double count). Amended before any generation or truth access: both 6.0 coefficients on the k31 expression corrected to 3.0, rebuilt to sha 702e971c..., re-screened by the target-free A/B, and re-audited. No pilot metric existed at amendment time.
arms.paired: Both arms run fresh on identical rows; every difference in the comparison is the carrier.

stage1_generation.roster: ranks 35..234 (the frozen native pilot roster), both arms
stage1_generation.output: rows/{base,k22r4}/row_NNNN/{host.npy,raw20.npy,sigma.npy,result.json} in this package; existing stores never written
stage1_generation.validation: per row and arm: host [16,1024] finite nonnegative, raw20 [16,1024,20] finite, sigma [16,1024] finite positive, flops_used <= 2^41, wall under 300 s local; no parity expectation between arms

stage2_scoring.truth: data_gate sealed observer_fit targets, rows 35..234 only, opened only after complete stage-1 coverage of BOTH arms
stage2_scoring.primary: paired raw final-layer MSE: mean over the 200 rows of mean((host[15] - truth[15])^2), base versus k22r4, plus per-row win count and the paired relative delta
stage2_scoring.secondary_diagnostic: refit-J corrected MSE on each arm's tape under exactly the frozen J-native transfer protocol (same 200-roster, same protected split, exact J architecture 25,600 parameters, model_seed 1753362478, shuffle stream 40, six epochs, fixed final checkpoint); diagnostic only, never gating
stage2_scoring.no_retune: No knob, rank, or emission variant is adjusted on any outcome; the r4 spelling closes as measured.

decision_gates.finite: every host/raw20/sigma finite per the stage-1 validation
decision_gates.achievability: The eight-row A/B already ran both arms on the harder public rows with every gate satisfied.

licensing_rules.raw_improvement_at_least_10pct: License the combined deployment-card build (residual-diet plus conditional repair plus carrier) as the next board candidate under the standing bank-quality bar (next fire ideally adjusted below 2e-8).
licensing_rules.raw_improvement_0_to_10pct: License rank/emission iteration only through a new frozen preregistration.
licensing_rules.raw_worse: Close the r4 spelling measured; the fifth-order diagonal carrier becomes the prime candidate.
licensing_rules.corrected_absorption_note: If raw improves but refit-J corrected does not, record the additive-invariant confirmation; the deployment goal is raw at full budget, so the raw verdict governs the card decision.

firewalls.submission: nothing in this package touches the board
